title: Naturality for one finite-family index
statement: For each index i of a positive finite family, there exists a derived arrow from K to C i such that every chain representative inducing that arrow satisfies the stated residue homology naturality equation.

proof.text: Fix an index i and apply the geometric comparison, derived direct-image functoriality, residue pullback, and K-flat comparison to construct the arrow and establish the homology equation.
